title: fix(#4003): Remove unhandled promises
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Add eslint rules to check for unhandled promises
Fix all existing unhandled promise issues

Resolves #4003

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

Uncaught exeptions in promise are not caught by try catch blocks one level above them as they aren't bubbled up. 
So, lint rule enforcing this during compile time seemed to be the next best option. There could still be instances in runtime where this occurs (if we're using `void` to ignore promises).
